answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy places each newcomer on a horizon probation tier with a bond locked for 23 epochs. Three randomly selected auditors reproduce distinct tasks; a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. Full rewards unlock after six clean rounds, making fake identities costly and slow; task hashes preserve an auditable trail.
